lifecycle.source: Initial uncommitted 16-case SQL probe; final suite was expanded and API signatures now require a displayed revision
lifecycle.interpretation: Not 16 independent security vulnerabilities. Four permission cases concern business reads before write rejection: the Prisma extension already refused unauthorized writes. Archive had no audit; create/update/delete logged best effort. Coherent archive and delete are functional witnesses.
